starting_weights: Official YOLOv8s COCO weights; exact stages listed below
epochs_completed_note: Sum of completed training-run epochs; each stage uses its development-selected best checkpoint.

training_stages.起点: 前阶段开发最优检查点

data_origin: Real camera photographs, not synthetic or generated images
scope: Selected only on PKLot development photos. The already published 36 PKLot photos are historical regression; 54 CNR photos from one other parking lot form a separate external evaluation. Neither dataset was used to change the frozen model or thresholds.
